propositions: Provider qualification must be decided by membership in a known registry (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset of 24 pydantic-ai names), not by prefix shape matching a regex pattern
Configured providers must be validated against KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES at config resolution time in _resolve_target, raising LLMConfigError with the offending value and valid names listed
Inline unrecognized provider prefixes in model strings must not raise; split_provider_qualifier returns (None, model) when prefix is not a member, keeping multi-colon model ids intact

Five provider names containing slashes (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) must now split correctly after replacing the shape regex with membership test
Neither 'test' nor 'google_genai' is a member of KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES; test usage-log assertions recording provider must change to assert absence rather than 'test' value
Drift between static set and runtime registries must be guarded by a one-directional test (runtime names subset of static set) using pytest.importorskip to avoid optional dependency
